title: The view was only the beginning.
subject: The Philippines, beyond the postcard
paragraphs: The view was only the beginning.
The full Philippines story is now on the website.
A bus ride that kept getting longer. Rooftop sunsets with friends. A kayak beneath El Nido's cliffs. And weather that had other ideas about our plans.

I've put the whole Philippines adventure on the website, with 40 photographs, travel films and little facts along the way . You can browse the photos and videos with the same simple arrows, or settle in for the story behind them.
Start with the views. Follow whichever moment catches your eye.
A new chapter is nearly here.

On 28 October, I'm launching a new “Buy me a coffee” option for anyone who would like to support the stories—always optional, always appreciated. It arrives alongside trip-status updates and the first destination reveal .
Where am I heading first? I'm keeping that secret until launch.
Enjoyed a particular photo or film? Share the story link with someone you'd take along.
